name: Automated Trading Workflow with Grok AI & RAG

assignments.name: marketSummary
assignments.value: Current market conditions. Price action showing consolidation. Volume is moderate.

parameters.query:
=SELECT 
  id,
  symbol,
  timeframe,
  direction,
  confidence,
  rationale,
  is_win,
  created_at,
  (embedding <=> (SELECT embedding FROM trade_ideas WHERE symbol = '{{ $json.symbol }}' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1)) as similarity
FROM trade_ideas
WHERE symbol = '{{ $json.symbol }}'
  AND embedding IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 5

parameters.jsonOutput:
={
  "workflow": "Automated Trading Analysis",
  "timestamp": "{{ $now }}",
  "status": "{{ $('Check Confidence Threshold').item.json.confidence >= parseFloat($env.CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD || '0.7') ? 'SUCCESS' : 'REJECTED_LOW_CONFIDENCE' }}",
  "symbol": "{{ $('Parse Grok Response').item.json.symbol }}",
  "confidence": "{{ $('Parse Grok Response').item.json.confidence }}",
  "direction": "{{ $('Parse Grok Response').item.json.direction }}",
  "saved_to_db": "{{ $('Check Confidence Threshold').item.json.confidence >= parseFloat($env.CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD || '0.7') }}",
  "notification_sent": "{{ $('Check Confidence Threshold').item.json.confidence >= parseFloat($env.CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD || '0.7') }}"
}
